Remark
[Weak formulation of Stokes' problem] ↗ thm:pressure-lagrange-multiplier-stokes 1. ch8:8.4.4-rem-1\group Incompressible Fluids

Identity (39) is the weak formulation of Stokes’ problem \[ \begin{cases} -\Delta \mathbf{u} = \mathbf{f} - Dp & \text{in } U \\ \Div \mathbf{u} = 0 & \text{in } U \\ \mathbf{u} = 0 & \text{on } \partial U. \end{cases} \tag {40} \] The function $p$ is the pressure and arises as a Lagrange multiplier corresponding to the incompressibility condition $\Div \mathbf{u} = 0$.
